name: subagents-workflow
description: A skill-only plugin for planning, delegating, coordinating, recovering, and validating native subagent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and validate native subagent work
interface.longDescription: Use native subagent primitives with bounded task contracts, non-overlapping ownership, event-driven coordination, recovery, integration review, and explicit completion criteria.
defaultPrompt: Use subagents to implement this task with clear ownership and final validation.
Split this investigation across parallel agents, then integrate the findings.
Review this change with independent implementation and verification agents.
